subject: english
stem: Claim: Advance weather alerts can help outdoor events prepare. Which example supports the mechanism?
options: A storm occurred without any event.
The alert used a blue icon.
Staff read an old menu after the storm.
After a wind alert, staff secured tents before the storm.

optionRationales.reason: A storm occurred without any event.：無 alert/preparation。
The alert used a blue icon.：無行動結果。
Staff read an old menu after the storm.：時間與內容不合。
After a wind alert, staff secured tents before the storm.：alert 導向事前準備。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「例子必須具備主張中的關鍵條件，且結果方向能作為該主張的具體個案」可推出 After a wind alert, staff secured tents before the storm.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 After a wind alert, staff secured tents before the storm. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
